Name: Min VWAP Extension (pts)
Description: Min distance from VWAP before fade (v2 wider buffer)

Name: Entry Band ATR Multiplier
Description: ATR band around VWAP for extension

Name: Reversion Confirm Bars
Description: Consecutive bars reverting toward VWAP before entry

Name: ATR Length
Description: ATR period for bands and stops

Name: Trade Start After OR (min)
Description: Extra buffer after OR before entries

Name: Trade End Before RTH Close (min)
Description: Stop new trades N min before close

Name: Max ADX Threshold
Description: Trade mean reversion when ADX below cap (v2 tighter max)

Name: Stop ATR Multiplier
Description: Initial stop distance (v2 capped; was 2.5 max)

Name: TP VWAP Buffer (pts)
Description: Exit when within N pts of VWAP (v2 tighter)

Name: Max Hold (bars)
Description: Time stop (~2-8h at TF=5-15; v2 longer hold band)

Name: MIN_TRADES_DAY
Description: Min activity floor (v2 slightly lower for fewer signals)

Name: MIN_WIN_RATE
Description: Min win rate (v2 allows sub-50% MR skew)

Name: WEIGHT_PNL
Description: Fitness: total PnL (v2 up-weight contiguous edge)

Name: MAX_WIN_RATE_CAP
Description: Suspicious win-rate cap (v2 lower; wide stops inflated WR)
